links.outcome: Readability of chatbot chronic cough responses versus recommended 6th-grade reading level
links.effect: Although Copilot demonstrated comparatively better readability, no model achieved the recommended 6th-grade reading level.
links.quote: Although Copilot demonstrated comparatively better readability, no model achieved the recommended 6th-grade reading level.

links.outcome: Accuracy and completeness of chatbot chronic cough answers against ERS guidelines
links.effect: Pooled accuracy reached 80.39%, but critical clinical details were frequently omitted across all models; Copilot systematically omitted guideline-based content.
links.quote: Pooled accuracy reached 80.39%, but critical clinical details were frequently omitted across all models.

screen.reason: Evaluates the accuracy, reliability, readability, and guideline adherence of six generative AI chatbots responding to chronic cough queries without testing specific organizational deployment practices or safeguards.
